Rae: Noticed discrepancy on the cost dashboard: route /generate shows warm_hit counts but per-model unit-econ credits drop to zero for ~45s during a spike. Anyone else?
Omar: Which model and panel?
Rae: model: redwood-mini, panel: per-model unit-econ (last 10m). Raw token_events show many warm_token hits but credited_tokens=0 in that slice.
Tess: Could be the recent 'collapse-ephemeral-batches' change. If batches are collapsed aggressively, reconciler might skip emitting credits.
Rae: I ran a quick SQL to compare:
```
SELECT sum(warm_tokens) as warm, sum(credited_tokens) as credits
FROM token_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN 5087654000 AND 5087654300
AND route = '/generate';
```
Result: warm=9,600, credits=0.
deploy-bot: deploy 5087654305 - reconciler v2.11 (flag: collapse-ephemeral-batches=true).
Omar: That deploy matches the timeframe. Can we rollback the flag? Short-term mitigation: emit provisional credits when owner resolution returns null, mark provisional=true so UI can show them separately.
Tess: Agreed. UX action: show "provisional" badge on unit-econ card and an explainability tooltip linking to reconciler_version and docs. Avoid customers seeing "0 credits" and assuming cache broken.
Rae: Ops rolled back canary automatically. deploy-bot: rollback 5087654330 - reconciler v2.11 -> v2.10 (auto-rollback).
Nina: I'll own the provisional emit patch (add credited_provisional boolean + reconciler_version tag) and a short alert rule: warm_hits > 2k/min and credited_tokens=0 -> SEV-3. Estimate ~2h to ship.
Omar: I'll script a staging burst to validate parity between raw events and reconciler after the patch.
Rae: Thanks. Action items: provisional emit (Nina), staging test (Omar), UX tooltip (Tess). Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
